metadata.comparison_method: Primary-source qualitative capability comparison; no comparative execution benchmark was performed.
metadata.baseline_scope: Inspected Eshkol public quantum module/shim and linked source snapshot, not all Moonlab capabilities or all Eshkol modules.

comparators.name: Q#
comparators.documented_strength: Hardware-independent quantum programs with qubit management and classical control.
comparators.comparison_boundary: Language safety and hardware portability do not establish application advantage.
comparators.implication_for_eshkol: Make resource lifetimes and target capabilities explicit in the quantum API.

comparators.name: OpenQASM 3
comparators.documented_strength: Gates, classical control, timing, measurement and calibration syntax.
comparators.comparison_boundary: A specification is not an execution service; implementations support different subsets.
comparators.implication_for_eshkol: Export a declared subset, reject unsupported constructs and test round trips.

comparators.name: Quil
comparators.documented_strength: Gate modifiers, classical memory/control and pulse-control annex.
comparators.comparison_boundary: The inspected specification labels itself 2021.1 DRAFT; do not assume every backend implements it.
comparators.implication_for_eshkol: Separate abstract circuit intent from backend-specific instructions.

comparators.name: Quipper
comparators.documented_strength: Hierarchical circuit construction, reversible synthesis and multiple staging phases.
comparators.comparison_boundary: Research-language documentation is not a current hardware-service support guarantee.
comparators.implication_for_eshkol: Add composable circuit transforms and explicit circuit-generation versus execution stages.

comparators.name: Silq
comparators.documented_strength: Strong static types and safe automatic uncomputation.
comparators.comparison_boundary: Its research design is useful precedent, not evidence of broad production deployment.
comparators.implication_for_eshkol: Integrate quantum resource types with a sound uncomputation discipline.

comparators.name: Qiskit
comparators.documented_strength: Circuit workflows, optimization, specialized packages and IBM QPU execution.
comparators.comparison_boundary: Qiskit, runtime services and addons are separate components; do not count the whole ecosystem as one language.
comparators.implication_for_eshkol: Prioritize real provider adapters, portable circuits and execution provenance.

comparators.name: Cirq
comparators.documented_strength: Hardware-aware circuits plus state-vector, density-matrix and noisy simulation.
comparators.comparison_boundary: Hardware access and noise models are target-specific; a simulator is still classical.
comparators.implication_for_eshkol: Represent devices, noise and shot-based results explicitly.

comparators.name: PennyLane
comparators.classification: differentiable quantum framework and compiler ecosystem
comparators.documented_strength: Quantum/classical differentiable workflows, chemistry tools, simulators and hardware integrations.
comparators.comparison_boundary: Gradient methods and devices have domains of validity; broad platform claims are not benchmarks.
comparators.implication_for_eshkol: Generalize the fixed VQE bridge while testing gradients against independent oracles.

comparators.name: CUDA-Q
comparators.classification: hybrid programming model, embedded languages and toolchain
comparators.documented_strength: CPU/GPU/QPU workflows, simulator backends, dynamics and multi-GPU execution.
comparators.comparison_boundary: Current docs distinguish logical tooling preview and pulse research preview from supported features.
comparators.implication_for_eshkol: Define device/runtime interfaces and measure transfer-inclusive performance.

comparators.name: Qrisp
comparators.documented_strength: Typed quantum variables, automatic uncomputation, arithmetic and block-encoding abstractions.
comparators.comparison_boundary: Its large-qubit sparse-simulation examples apply to some circuits, not arbitrary states.
comparators.implication_for_eshkol: Build reusable quantum data abstractions without hiding state-size assumptions.

comparators.name: Qmod
comparators.documented_strength: Functional models compiled and synthesized under circuit-property constraints.
comparators.comparison_boundary: Native and Python forms are the same language, not two comparators; graphical support is a subset.
comparators.implication_for_eshkol: Offer explicit resource constraints and inspectable synthesized circuits.

comparators.name: BQSKit
comparators.documented_strength: Circuit IR, numerical synthesis, extensible compiler passes and distributed compilation.
comparators.comparison_boundary: A compiler framework does not itself supply all algorithm or hardware services.
comparators.implication_for_eshkol: Adopt pass contracts, cost functions and verification for circuit optimization.

comparators.name: TKET / pytket
comparators.documented_strength: Native-gate compilation, placement, routing and multiple backend integrations.
comparators.comparison_boundary: Device feasibility must be checked after transformations; optimization is workload-dependent.
comparators.implication_for_eshkol: Treat routing and native-gate legality as independently tested compiler stages.

comparators.name: Amazon Braket SDK
comparators.documented_strength: Common access to simulators, gate devices, analog hardware and hybrid workflows.
comparators.comparison_boundary: Provider availability, charges and hardware characteristics are service-specific.
comparators.implication_for_eshkol: Add explicit job state, shot budgets and result provenance, with simulator-only defaults.

comparators.name: Qibo
comparators.documented_strength: Backend drivers, algorithm examples, tomography and hybrid research workflows.
comparators.comparison_boundary: The fetched stable docs identify v0.3.6; optional components are not all core functions.
comparators.implication_for_eshkol: Provide backend-independent experiments with numerical reference results.

comparators.name: Qulacs
comparators.documented_strength: Noisy and parametric circuit simulation, density matrices and circuit-learning examples.
comparators.comparison_boundary: Simulation speed and scale depend on circuit/state representation and hardware.
comparators.implication_for_eshkol: Benchmark specialized simulation kernels against strong classical baselines.

comparators.name: Yao.jl
comparators.documented_strength: Composable quantum blocks, algorithm construction and GPU/tensor-network companion packages.
comparators.comparison_boundary: The repository calls itself early-release beta; companion packages are distinct dependencies.
comparators.implication_for_eshkol: Use compositional circuits and expose backend extensions without overstating core scope.

comparators.name: QuantumOptics.jl
comparators.documented_strength: Hilbert-space-aware objects, master equations, trajectories, steady states and correlations.
comparators.comparison_boundary: This is a scientific simulator, not a gate-QPU programming language.
comparators.implication_for_eshkol: Separate open-system dynamics from gate circuits while sharing typed observables.

comparators.name: Strawberry Fields
comparators.classification: photonic quantum SDK / embedded circuit DSL
comparators.documented_strength: Photonic circuits, simulation backends and differentiable program optimization.
comparators.comparison_boundary: The stable URL redirects to 0.24.0-dev documentation; current cloud access was not verified.
comparators.implication_for_eshkol: Treat continuous-variable photonics as a distinct model with truncation checks.

comparators.name: Perceval
comparators.documented_strength: Linear-optics components, Fock states, source-error models and Quandela QPU interface.
comparators.comparison_boundary: Discrete-photon and continuous-variable models are not interchangeable.
comparators.implication_for_eshkol: Add a separate photonic adapter and preserve heralding and postselection statistics.

comparators.name: Pulser
comparators.documented_strength: Device-constrained pulse sequences and analog neutral-atom simulation.
comparators.comparison_boundary: Pulse validity depends on a particular device, not just a circuit equivalence relation.
comparators.implication_for_eshkol: Validate geometry, timing and waveform constraints in an analog execution layer.

comparators.name: Qadence
comparators.documented_strength: Block-based programs, symbolic parameters, analog generators and differentiable workflows.
comparators.comparison_boundary: Model/backend support must be checked per operation; not every pulse is differentiable.
comparators.implication_for_eshkol: Keep digital/analog differentiation contracts explicit and testable.

comparators.name: Bloqade
comparators.classification: neutral-atom SDK and compiler DSL ecosystem
comparators.documented_strength: Analog/digital experiment workflows, atom movement, noisy near-Clifford simulation and QEC tools.
comparators.comparison_boundary: The current site exposes multiple packages and target products, not one universal language.
comparators.implication_for_eshkol: Model hardware geometry, losses and logical execution rather than assuming ideal gates.

comparators.name: ProjectQ
comparators.classification: embedded quantum DSL and compiler framework
comparators.documented_strength: Extensible compiler pipeline and quantum algorithm execution on simulators/devices.
comparators.comparison_boundary: The fetched docs are a development build; individual backend support must be rechecked.
comparators.implication_for_eshkol: Make compiler extensions small, inspectable and covered by functional tests.

comparators.name: Guppy
comparators.documented_strength: Linear qubit ownership, measurement-dependent control, metaprogramming and fault-tolerant extensions.
comparators.comparison_boundary: Guppy, its FT extension and Selene emulator have separate responsibilities.
comparators.implication_for_eshkol: Make the typed quantum language, runtime handles and execution model agree.

targets.title: Runtime quantum capability query
targets.baseline_evidence: Build flag and unavailable stubs exist; no unified Scheme capability report found.
targets.acceptance_criteria: A query reports build flag, simulator backend, ABI, supported operations and derivative modes; ON/OFF CI asserts each field without executing an unavailable operation.

targets.title: Reproducible optional quantum packages
targets.baseline_evidence: Opt-in source integration exists; this stream has not validated packaged ON builds.
targets.acceptance_criteria: Clean Windows, Linux and macOS jobs install a pinned ON package, run Bell/VQE smoke tests, and verify OFF builds return documented unavailability.

targets.title: Honest execution and entropy provenance
targets.baseline_evidence: Source labels exist but some prose conflates simulated Bell tests with physical certification.
targets.acceptance_criteria: Every result identifies classical simulator or named physical device; entropy output reports actual source and fallback events; no simulation is labelled device-independent certified entropy.

targets.title: Moonlab ABI and revision manifest
targets.baseline_evidence: CMake pins a commit while nearby comments/reference text mention other revisions.
targets.acceptance_criteria: Generated manifest records exact dependency commit and ABI; intentional mismatches fail before allocation; release docs are generated from the same manifest.

targets.title: Generational quantum handles
targets.baseline_evidence: Opaque integer tables and destroy helpers exist; stale-handle reuse needs a specified contract.
targets.acceptance_criteria: Allocate/free/reallocate fuzzing never lets a stale handle access a new state; double destruction is defined; invalid handles produce catchable errors under sanitizers.

targets.title: Typed qubit ownership through public APIs
targets.baseline_evidence: Linear Qubit exists, but state-handle plus integer-index wrappers do not establish full resource typing.
targets.acceptance_criteria: Compile-fail tests cover duplicate use, escaping aliases and interprocedural returns; valid scoped gates compile; runtime state ownership agrees with the static qubit identity.

targets.title: Uniform quantum error contract
targets.baseline_evidence: C shim uses error codes/NaN and wrappers translate selected failures.
targets.acceptance_criteria: Invalid counts, indices, angles, destroyed handles and allocation failures all produce documented catchable errors; no invalid case silently returns a plausible numeric result.

targets.title: Dense ideal-state correctness gate
targets.baseline_evidence: Dense state creation, gates, measurement and Z expectation have public wrappers and source tests.
targets.acceptance_criteria: Exhaustively compare all exposed 1- and 2-qubit gates with independent complex matrices; norm and expectation errors stay below 1e-12 in float64 fixtures.

targets.title: Seeded simulator replay
targets.baseline_evidence: Measurement wrapper uses a process entropy context; caller-supplied seed is not exposed.
targets.acceptance_criteria: A seed plus serialized program reproduces samples on the same version; different seeds pass distribution checks; deterministic replay is never advertised as physical entropy.

targets.title: Backend conformance ledger
targets.baseline_evidence: Source tests exist but no fresh complete native/VM/browser quantum matrix was run here.
targets.acceptance_criteria: Publish operation-by-engine supported/refused/untested statuses tied to executable tests; zero unsupported cases silently succeed; include release hashes and test logs.

targets.title: OpenQASM 3 export
targets.baseline_evidence: No public circuit export API found in the inspected module/shim.
targets.acceptance_criteria: Export a declared gate/measurement subset; an independent OpenQASM parser accepts 100 fixtures and simulation probabilities match within 1e-10.

targets.title: OpenQASM 3 import
targets.baseline_evidence: No public parser/import adapter found in the quantum surface.
targets.acceptance_criteria: Parse the declared subset with source locations; reject pulse/unsupported dynamic constructs explicitly; imported Bell, QFT and adaptive fixtures match reference behavior.

targets.title: QIR target profile
targets.baseline_evidence: LLVM compilation alone is not a QIR emitter; none found in inspected quantum interface.
targets.acceptance_criteria: Emit a named QIR profile with verified LLVM IR and required metadata; run at least 20 programs on an independent compatible executor.

targets.title: Quil interchange adapter
targets.baseline_evidence: No public Quil serializer/parser found in the quantum interface.
targets.acceptance_criteria: Round-trip gates, classical memory and measurement for a documented Quil subset; preserve bit order and reject pulse annexes until implemented.

targets.title: Typed circuit intermediate representation
targets.baseline_evidence: Current public API mutates opaque simulator state directly rather than exposing circuit objects.
targets.acceptance_criteria: Represent qubits, gates, parameters, measurements and dependencies with a versioned schema; validation catches dangling wires and parameter-type errors before execution.

targets.title: Portable observable and Hamiltonian interchange
targets.baseline_evidence: Pauli-string Hamiltonian construction exists; no general import/export schema found.
targets.acceptance_criteria: Serialize arbitrary Pauli sums, units, constants and wire order; round-trip 50 fixtures with identical coefficients and expectation values within 1e-12.

targets.title: Shot-result and bit-order schema
targets.baseline_evidence: Single-qubit measurement returns an integer; no portable batch-result schema found.
targets.acceptance_criteria: Specify endianness, register mapping, counts, shots, uncertainty and provenance; adapters pass asymmetric-bitstring tests that detect reversal errors.

targets.title: Backend plugin contract
targets.baseline_evidence: Moonlab is compiled into the shim; no public quantum backend plugin contract found.
targets.acceptance_criteria: Two independent simulator adapters implement capability discovery, execute, sample and observe; unsupported operations fail consistently without implicit backend substitution.

targets.title: PennyLane device integration
targets.baseline_evidence: No PennyLane-facing device plugin found in inspected Eshkol quantum surface.
targets.acceptance_criteria: A separately versioned plugin passes its declared device-conformance tests and a 20-case expectation/gradient comparison without copying parameters incorrectly.

targets.title: Quantum array interchange
targets.baseline_evidence: Quantum state is opaque; VQE parameters are marshalled through a dedicated context.
targets.acceptance_criteria: Exchange complex amplitudes and parameter arrays through a documented C/Python boundary; shape, ownership, dtype and lifetime tests catch aliasing and precision loss.

targets.title: Complete practical gate vocabulary
targets.baseline_evidence: H, X, Y, Z, CNOT, RX, RY and RZ are exposed; many standard gates are not.
targets.acceptance_criteria: Add S, T, CZ, SWAP and controlled rotations or verified decompositions; compare matrices including global-phase conventions and invalid-wire cases.

targets.title: Controlled and adjoint circuit combinators
targets.baseline_evidence: No general circuit modifier API is exposed.
targets.acceptance_criteria: Controlled and inverse transforms compose over supported circuits; random unitary fixtures satisfy U-dagger times U within 1e-10 and measurement inversion is rejected.

targets.title: Safe automatic uncomputation
targets.baseline_evidence: Classical region memory does not implement quantum uncomputation.
targets.acceptance_criteria: For a declared reversible subset, compiler-generated cleanup returns ancillas to zero and preserves output coherence; unsafe erasures fail static checking.

targets.title: Ancilla allocation and reuse planner
targets.baseline_evidence: State allocation exists, but no circuit-level ancilla liveness planner is exposed.
targets.acceptance_criteria: Report peak live ancillas and verified reuse intervals; transformed circuits match references and never reuse an entangled live ancilla.

targets.title: Measurement-dependent circuit control
targets.baseline_evidence: Host Scheme can branch on measurement; portable in-circuit feedback representation is not established.
targets.acceptance_criteria: Represent mid-circuit measurement, reset, conditionals and bounded loops; teleportation and repeat-until-success fixtures match simulator/reference distributions.

targets.title: Topology-aware routing
targets.baseline_evidence: No target connectivity/routing abstraction found in public quantum interface.
targets.acceptance_criteria: Route 50 fixed circuits to line/grid/device graphs; every two-qubit operation is legal, semantics preserved, and swap overhead is reported.

targets.title: Native-gate synthesis
targets.baseline_evidence: Direct simulator gate calls do not form a target synthesis pipeline.
targets.acceptance_criteria: Compile arbitrary tested 1-/2-qubit unitaries to a declared basis with chosen error budget; verify achieved error and report gate count and synthesis time.

targets.title: Local circuit optimization passes
targets.baseline_evidence: No quantum pass-manager API found in exposed surface.
targets.acceptance_criteria: Cancellation, rotation fusion and commuting passes preserve 100 random small-circuit unitaries within 1e-10; publish before/after depth and count.

targets.title: ZX optimization interoperability
targets.baseline_evidence: No ZX diagram adapter found in quantum surface.
targets.acceptance_criteria: Export/import a defined Clifford+T subset to PyZX; certify equality or clearly report unverifiable cases; record T-count and extraction failures.

targets.title: Proof-checked unitary rewrite kernel
targets.baseline_evidence: General Eshkol proof types do not constitute verified quantum rewrite rules.
targets.acceptance_criteria: Mechanize semantics and prove at least five implemented rewrites; generated optimizer only uses checked rules, with numeric tests as secondary evidence.

targets.title: Density-matrix simulator adapter
targets.baseline_evidence: Public binding exposes dense pure states, not density matrices.
targets.acceptance_criteria: Bell-state partial trace gives maximally mixed marginals; trace and positivity tests pass; small noisy circuits match an independent density simulator within 1e-10.

targets.title: Validated Kraus and noise channels
targets.baseline_evidence: No public channel/noise-model constructor found.
targets.acceptance_criteria: Implement depolarizing, dephasing and amplitude damping; validate completeness within tolerance and reject non-physical channel inputs.

targets.title: Quantum trajectory simulation
targets.baseline_evidence: No trajectory ensemble API found in public binding.
targets.acceptance_criteria: Ensemble averages converge to density-matrix references with declared confidence intervals; logs record trajectory count, seeds and sampling error separately from solver error.

targets.title: Lindblad time evolution
targets.baseline_evidence: Moonlab integration references other engines; public module has no open-system solver.
targets.acceptance_criteria: Damped two-level analytic solutions and independent solver fixtures agree under a documented tolerance; step refinement verifies convergence and trace preservation.

targets.title: Stabilizer simulator backend
targets.baseline_evidence: No tableau/stabilizer operations exposed in the binding.
targets.acceptance_criteria: Execute Clifford circuits through a tested adapter; match exact small-system probabilities and run a 1000-qubit stabilizer fixture without exponential state storage.

targets.title: Tensor-network simulation binding
targets.baseline_evidence: Design names Moonlab CA-MPS/TDVP APIs but public module does not bind them.
targets.acceptance_criteria: Expose bond/truncation controls with discarded-weight diagnostics; match small exact references and show convergence as bond dimension increases.

targets.title: GPU-resident quantum state execution
targets.baseline_evidence: Integration config disables optional Moonlab accelerators; general Eshkol GPU support does not prove this path.
targets.acceptance_criteria: Demonstrate actual device-resident gate execution and synchronization tests; report memory, correctness and end-to-end speed versus CPU including transfers.

targets.title: Distributed quantum simulation
targets.baseline_evidence: No multi-node quantum state partitioning API found in exposed binding.
targets.acceptance_criteria: Run one reproducible distributed state-vector fixture on two nodes; compare checksum/observables to a serial reference and report communication-inclusive scaling.

targets.title: Qudit state and gate support
targets.baseline_evidence: Public API uses qubit counts and binary gates.
targets.acceptance_criteria: Support dimension-3 registers and mixed-dimension validation; qutrit Fourier/controlled-shift fixtures preserve norm and match independent matrices.

targets.title: Continuous-variable photonic model
targets.baseline_evidence: Public API is qubit state-vector/VQE, with no Fock/Gaussian abstraction.
targets.acceptance_criteria: Implement or adapt Gaussian/Fock operations; coherent/squeezed-state observables agree with references and cutoff-convergence reports quantify truncation error.

targets.title: Preserve ideal VQE adjoint correctness
targets.baseline_evidence: vqe-energy custom VJP and vqe-gradient plus adversarial source tests exist.
targets.acceptance_criteria: On quantum-enabled releases, compare AD, direct VJP and central differences over random nonstationary points; maximum gradient error below 1e-6 and no unexplained zero gradients.

targets.title: User-defined variational ansatz
targets.baseline_evidence: Public VQE uses a fixed one-layer hardware-efficient ansatz.
targets.acceptance_criteria: Users construct 3 distinct trainable circuit families; arbitrary parameter mapping is preserved and expectations/gradients match independent references.

targets.title: Shot-based parameter-shift gradients
targets.baseline_evidence: A native analytic fallback is documented, but user-controlled shot-based gradient execution is not exposed.
targets.acceptance_criteria: Estimate eligible gate derivatives with shot budgets and confidence intervals; 95% interval coverage is checked over repeated seeds against analytic small cases.

targets.title: General adjoint circuit differentiation
targets.baseline_evidence: Adjoint path exists for default ideal VQE, not arbitrary exposed circuit objects.
targets.acceptance_criteria: Differentiate user circuits with 1, 10 and 100 parameters; match parameter-shift references and publish peak memory/runtime as depth and width vary.

targets.title: Second-order quantum derivative contract
targets.baseline_evidence: Arbitrary-order host AD does not establish arbitrary higher-order derivatives through the opaque VQE primitive.
targets.acceptance_criteria: Specify supported Hessian/JVP compositions; test symmetry and finite differences; unsupported nesting raises a named error rather than returning zero.

targets.title: General quantum geometric tensor
targets.baseline_evidence: vqe-qgt currently assumes four parameters and returns 4x4 entries.
targets.acceptance_criteria: Accept variable parameter counts; compare to state-derivative references, test symmetry/positive semidefiniteness, and state gauge and regularization conventions.

targets.title: Differentiation through noisy channels
targets.baseline_evidence: Public VQE bridge describes ideal-state energy and gradients.
targets.acceptance_criteria: Differentiate at least two parameterized CPTP channels; compare with density-matrix finite differences and distinguish stochastic estimator variance from numerical bias.

targets.title: Batched parameter sweeps and gradients
targets.baseline_evidence: Public VQE evaluator takes one parameter vector per call.
targets.acceptance_criteria: Batch 32 independent parameter sets; outputs match serial runs, ordering is stable, and timing includes marshaling and device transfers.

targets.title: Restartable hybrid optimizer workflow
targets.baseline_evidence: vqe-optimize offers an iteration count with a fixed default optimizer; general state/checkpoint control is not exposed.
targets.acceptance_criteria: Export optimizer state, RNG and parameters; an interrupted run resumes to the same seeded result, with loss/gradient/shot histories preserved.

targets.title: Quantum derivative refusal and coverage manifest
targets.baseline_evidence: Dedicated VQE checks exist; generic derivative coverage across new backends is not established.
targets.acceptance_criteria: Every operation/backend/order combination is supported or explicitly refused; negative tests cover measurement branches, unsupported channels and nested AD without silent zeros.

targets.title: General chemistry Hamiltonian import
targets.baseline_evidence: Fixed H2/LiH/H2O constructors and arbitrary Pauli sums exist.
targets.acceptance_criteria: Import a documented electronic-integral or Pauli dataset with basis, geometry and units; validate at least five small molecules against independent diagonalization.

targets.title: Symmetry tapering and sector selection
targets.baseline_evidence: Public Hamiltonian construction accepts an HF bitmask but no tapering transformation.
targets.acceptance_criteria: Identify supported commuting symmetries; reduced and unreduced sector spectra agree on small fixtures; invalid sector requests are rejected.

targets.title: Excited-state and spectral workflows
targets.baseline_evidence: Public helpers focus on ground-state reference/VQE energy.
targets.acceptance_criteria: Compute two excited energies and overlaps for small Hamiltonians with declared method; independent eigensolver agreement and orthogonality checks are mandatory.

targets.title: Quantum phase estimation library
targets.baseline_evidence: No public QPE combinator found in quantum module.
targets.acceptance_criteria: Known eigenphase fixtures recover each phase to the requested bits; account for ancillas, controlled-evolution synthesis and failure probability.

targets.title: Amplitude estimation library
targets.baseline_evidence: No exposed amplitude-estimation routine found.
targets.acceptance_criteria: Estimate a set of known Bernoulli amplitudes; observed confidence coverage matches declared guarantees and oracle-call counts include state preparation.

targets.title: QAOA with explicit classical baseline
targets.baseline_evidence: Public quantum layer exposes VQE but no QAOA constructor.
targets.acceptance_criteria: Small MaxCut instances match exhaustive optimum bounds; report approximation ratio, shots and total time against named classical solvers without claiming generic advantage.

targets.title: Hamiltonian time-evolution circuits
targets.baseline_evidence: Gate wrappers do not expose a compositional simulation algorithm library.
targets.acceptance_criteria: Trotter/Suzuki evolution matches matrix exponentials on small models; refinement demonstrates expected convergence and error budgets include synthesis.

targets.title: Block encoding and quantum signal processing
targets.baseline_evidence: No public block-encoding/QSP construction API found.
targets.acceptance_criteria: For bounded small matrices, verify top-left block encoding and polynomial transformation numerically; report normalization, oracle and approximation costs.

targets.title: Tomography and classical-shadow experiments
targets.baseline_evidence: Z expectation exists; reconstruction/measurement-design workflows are not exposed.
targets.acceptance_criteria: Reconstruct specified small states/observables with uncertainty intervals, record shot counts and test coverage over independent seeds.

targets.title: Discrete-photon experiment adapter
targets.baseline_evidence: No public linear-optics/Fock-state interface found.
targets.acceptance_criteria: Run Hong-Ou-Mandel and a heralded small-circuit fixture through an adapter; preserve raw/postselected counts and model source/detector errors explicitly.

targets.title: First physical gate-QPU adapter
targets.baseline_evidence: Exposed Moonlab interface is a classical simulator; no QPU submission path found.
targets.acceptance_criteria: Submit a validated small program to one named physical device, record job ID/calibration/shots and reproduce retrieval; mocked tests never count as hardware validation.

targets.title: Device topology and calibration snapshot
targets.baseline_evidence: No public physical-device model found.
targets.acceptance_criteria: Version connectivity, basis gates, durations and calibration timestamp; compilation rejects incompatible circuits and records exactly which snapshot it used.

targets.title: Durable asynchronous quantum jobs
targets.baseline_evidence: Local simulator calls are synchronous and no quantum job handle API is exposed.
targets.acceptance_criteria: Submission, polling, cancellation and restart recovery are idempotent; mocked failure tests cannot double-submit a chargeable job and preserve final provenance.

targets.title: Execution and shot budget enforcement
targets.baseline_evidence: No QPU cost/shot budget API found.
targets.acceptance_criteria: A preflight policy caps shots, retries and estimated spend; tests show retries cannot exceed caps; actual usage reconciles against recorded jobs.

targets.title: Pulse and timing representation
targets.baseline_evidence: No public pulse/frame/waveform representation found.
targets.acceptance_criteria: Represent frames, durations and waveforms with units; enforce target sample/timing limits; round-trip a documented pulse subset with no unit conversion ambiguity.

targets.title: Neutral-atom geometry and waveform adapter
targets.baseline_evidence: Public API has no atom positions, blockade model or analog program object.
targets.acceptance_criteria: Validate inter-atom spacing, channel limits and waveform schedules against one device schema; compare Rabi and small Ising simulations with references.

targets.title: Digital-analog program composition
targets.baseline_evidence: Quantum module exposes gates and fixed VQE, not mixed analog blocks.
targets.acceptance_criteria: Compose gate and Hamiltonian-evolution blocks with explicit units; ideal small-system results and parameter derivatives match an independent solver.

targets.title: Hardware feedback latency contract
targets.baseline_evidence: Host branching does not guarantee device-resident or bounded-latency feedback.
targets.acceptance_criteria: Measure control round-trip distributions on one backend and declare limits; unsupported feedback is rejected, with no claim of hard real-time bounds from arena allocation.

targets.title: Readout mitigation with uncertainty
targets.baseline_evidence: No public physical measurement-calibration model found.
targets.acceptance_criteria: Calibrate a small readout matrix; report corrected estimates, uncertainty and conditioning; held-out tests show when correction worsens results.

targets.title: Error mitigation under a fixed budget
targets.baseline_evidence: No ZNE/PEC experiment framework exposed.
targets.acceptance_criteria: Implement one mitigation protocol with raw and corrected outputs; compare mean-squared error at equal total shots, including calibration overhead and failure regimes.

targets.title: Logical-versus-physical qubit model
targets.baseline_evidence: Qubit type and simulator count do not encode code distance or logical operations.
targets.acceptance_criteria: Resource objects distinguish logical qubits, physical qubits, code distance and gate level; mixing incompatible levels fails validation.

targets.title: Stabilizer-code construction library
targets.baseline_evidence: No public QEC code constructor found.
targets.acceptance_criteria: Generate repetition and distance-3/5 surface-code circuits; ideal syndromes and every single-Pauli injection match independently checked expectations.

targets.title: Detector error model interchange
targets.baseline_evidence: No detector/syndrome schema exposed.
targets.acceptance_criteria: Export detector models for declared noise assumptions; an independent decoder consumes them and fault-injection checks preserve detector/observable mappings.

targets.title: Decoder plugin and throughput harness
targets.baseline_evidence: Moonlab design names decoder registries; Eshkol module does not expose them.
targets.acceptance_criteria: Two decoders consume the same syndrome batches; publish logical error, latency percentiles and throughput on fixed seeds/hardware with no unmeasured real-time claim.

targets.title: Logical error scaling experiments
targets.baseline_evidence: No public code-distance/noise sweep workflow found.
targets.acceptance_criteria: Sweep at least three code distances and noise rates with confidence intervals; fit suppression only in measured regimes and expose insufficient-statistics outcomes.

targets.title: Clifford+T synthesis error budget
targets.baseline_evidence: No fault-tolerant gate/resource compiler surface found.
targets.acceptance_criteria: Lower supported rotations to Clifford+T with a declared synthesis bound; verify small unitaries and account separately for algorithmic, synthesis and physical error.

targets.title: Magic-state factory resource model
targets.baseline_evidence: No public distillation/factory model found.
targets.acceptance_criteria: Compute physical-qubit/time estimates for named protocols under explicit input errors; reproduce a published small reference table and include parameter sensitivity.

targets.title: Logical scheduling and lattice-surgery plan
targets.baseline_evidence: No logical layout/schedule representation found.
targets.acceptance_criteria: Compile a small logical workload into a legal schedule for one architecture model; report space-time volume and validate resource conflicts.

targets.title: Fault-tolerant resource estimation adapter
targets.baseline_evidence: No public estimator bridge found; language compilation alone is insufficient.
targets.acceptance_criteria: Export a supported workload to an external estimator; preserve assumptions and compare physical qubits/runtime across at least three hardware/code scenarios.

targets.title: Cross-layer resource and error budget ledger
targets.baseline_evidence: No unified algorithm-to-physical cost ledger found.
targets.acceptance_criteria: A chemistry or phase-estimation example records precision, success probability, logical operations, factories and physical resources without double-counting overhead.

targets.title: Executable quantum documentation
targets.baseline_evidence: Quantum examples/source tests exist but this stream did not execute every published example on every target.
targets.acceptance_criteria: CI extracts all quantum examples, runs declared supported targets, and marks external hardware prerequisites; wrong expected outputs block release.

targets.title: Quantum-aware diagnostics
targets.baseline_evidence: Wrapper error messages exist; circuit source mapping and richer diagnostics are absent.
targets.acceptance_criteria: Invalid wires, nonunitary gates, impossible ownership and unsupported target features report source spans and actionable reasons in 30 negative fixtures.

targets.title: Circuit and state visualization
targets.baseline_evidence: No public circuit object/visualizer found in the binding.
targets.acceptance_criteria: Render circuits with parameter/measurement labels and small-state plots; snapshots preserve wire order and explicitly mark simulator-only state access.

targets.title: Quantum profiling trace
targets.baseline_evidence: No unified quantum compile/execute/transfer/shot trace exposed.
targets.acceptance_criteria: Emit machine-readable spans for compilation, marshaling, transfers, execution and sampling; totals reconcile with wall time within documented instrumentation overhead.

targets.title: Pinned reproducible experiment bundles
targets.baseline_evidence: Dependency pinning exists; no universal experiment/result bundle schema was established here.
targets.acceptance_criteria: Bundle program, dependency hashes, seeds, device snapshot, environment, raw results and analysis; a clean runner reproduces a seeded simulator experiment.

targets.title: Differential quantum fuzzing
targets.baseline_evidence: Source quantum tests exist; broad cross-tool randomized differential evidence is not established.
targets.acceptance_criteria: Generate 1000 small valid circuits and compare independent engines with phase/shot-aware tolerances; minimize every mismatch into a retained regression.

targets.title: Application benchmark protocol
targets.baseline_evidence: Existing quantum microbenchmarks do not establish a 25-system application ranking.
targets.acceptance_criteria: Freeze workload families, precision, hardware, seeds and time-to-solution metrics before measurement; publish failures and tuning budgets alongside successes.

targets.title: Independent replication package
targets.baseline_evidence: No independent replication of this proposed comparative protocol has occurred.
targets.acceptance_criteria: A second team or isolated environment reruns the published bundle; discrepancies are logged and resolved before any leadership claim.

targets.title: Quantum extension compatibility governance
targets.baseline_evidence: General project contribution rules exist; quantum plugin/version promises are not established.
targets.acceptance_criteria: Publish semantic-version and deprecation rules; two plugin versions run through a compatibility matrix and a deliberately incompatible ABI fails clearly.

targets.title: Scientific claim-to-evidence registry
targets.baseline_evidence: Existing docs mix implementation, historical design and performance/physical claims.
targets.acceptance_criteria: Every public quantum capability claim links to source, passing test or measured report and declares scope; simulation, hardware, projection and open research are distinct fields.

targets.title: Fault-tolerant chemistry beyond toy molecules
targets.baseline_evidence: Public molecular constructors/VQE do not demonstrate practical fault-tolerant chemistry.
targets.acceptance_criteria: Reproduce one small active-space reference end to end, then publish a larger-case resource estimate with basis/truncation/error budgets; independent chemistry review is required before a scientific claim.

targets.title: End-to-end advantage for a materials workload
targets.baseline_evidence: No matched classical-versus-quantum advantage experiment was established here.
targets.acceptance_criteria: Pre-register a meaningful observable, precision and total-cost metric; beat tuned classical baselines with reproducible evidence, or publish the null result. Simulation speed alone cannot close this target.

targets.title: Trainability-aware variational compiler
targets.baseline_evidence: Native AD supplies derivatives but does not remove barren plateaus or shot complexity.
targets.acceptance_criteria: On predefined circuit families, predict and measure gradient-variance scaling; compare initialization/ansatz strategies at equal budgets and publish counterexamples to claimed improvements.

targets.title: Mitigation with defensible cost guarantees
targets.baseline_evidence: No Eshkol result establishes mitigation benefit under general noise and equal sampling cost.
targets.acceptance_criteria: Derive assumptions and overhead bounds for one method, then test equal-cost error across increasing depth; explicitly report regimes where mitigation loses.

targets.title: Useful logical computation beyond memory experiments
targets.baseline_evidence: No logical hardware execution path or result exists in the inspected binding.
targets.acceptance_criteria: Execute a logical algorithm with repeated correction and compare to a defined physical implementation at equal task error; distinguish code-memory success from useful algorithmic advantage.

targets.title: Verified adaptive quantum compilation
targets.baseline_evidence: No proof links the quantum interface, dynamic control and backend lowering end to end.
targets.acceptance_criteria: Formalize a bounded adaptive subset and prove selected lowerings preserve measurement semantics; publish assumptions and proof artifacts, with adversarial tests for unproved boundaries.

targets.title: Learning from coherent experimental quantum data
targets.baseline_evidence: Simulator-generated datasets do not establish coherent-data experimental advantage.
targets.acceptance_criteria: Reproduce a small coherent-copy learning task with a physical-data protocol and explicit classical access model; compare sample complexity and account for state preparation/readout.

targets.title: Physical device-independent entropy integration
targets.baseline_evidence: Current simulated Bell/entropy layer is not a loophole-controlled physical Bell experiment.
targets.acceptance_criteria: Consume authenticated physical experiment records with stated independence assumptions, finite-size entropy bounds and extractor parameters; simulation-only mode must be incapable of claiming certification.

targets.title: Distributed quantum network programming
targets.baseline_evidence: No quantum network, entanglement-distribution or remote-state API is exposed.
targets.acceptance_criteria: Implement a simulator protocol with loss, fidelity and classical latency, then validate one hardware-linked entanglement task; report end-to-end success rates and assumptions.

targets.title: Reproducible frontier resource co-design
targets.baseline_evidence: No end-to-end hardware/code/algorithm Pareto study is exposed in Eshkol.
targets.acceptance_criteria: Reproduce a published resource scenario, vary algorithm/code/hardware assumptions, and publish non-dominated cost/error tradeoffs with sensitivity and independent checks; estimates remain projections.
